title: Position: Bayesian Statistics Facilitates Stakeholder Participation in Evaluation of Generative AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark study. It proposes a methodological framework (Bayesian workflow) for evaluating Generative AI but does not apply it to measure any specific aspect of faith or religion.
findings: This paper is a methodological position paper and does not contain any empirical findings related to religion. It proposes a framework for evaluation but does not apply it.
